ops.title: Re-enable the capt-hook self-updater after a safe host cutover to >=12.102.0
ops.description: The updater was disabled before merging PR #401 so v12.102.0 would not auto-supersede the host. The guard runs from a file overlay in the 12.101.15 env until a planned cutover.

ops.text: HOOKS_UPDATE_ENABLED removed from ~/.claude/settings.json env once the owner schedules a host supersede that does not stop adopted reviewers
Live host build >= v12.102.0 and the 12.101.15 overlay files no longer in use
